list_of_rare_earth_compounds.structure_description: DFX-Ce is isostructural with DFX-Eu and DFX-Gd. Bridging carboxylate ligands and a bridging water molecule connect lanthanide centers into cruciform-like one-dimensional coordination-polymer chains; hydrogen bonding and C–H⋯π contacts associate the chains into a three-dimensional supramolecular architecture.

synthesis.procedure: Ce(NO3)3·6H2O and deferasirox were stirred in water for 10 min at room temperature, transferred to a Teflon-lined stainless-steel vessel, and heated under autogenous pressure. After slow cooling to room temperature, the crystals were filtered, washed with distilled water, and dried in air.
synthesis.vessel_or_method: 20 mL Teflon-lined stainless-steel vessel; hydrothermal reaction
synthesis.workup_and_crystallization: Slow cooling to room temperature yielded yellow-green prism crystals; filtered, washed with distilled water, and dried in air.

list_of_rare_earth_compounds.structure_description: The asymmetric unit contains two independent Eu(III) centers, six bridging H2L− ligands, and one bridging water molecule. Carboxylate bridges and water connect the Eu centers into a cruciform-like one-dimensional chain along the a axis. Interchain hydrogen bonds and C–H⋯π interactions produce a three-dimensional supramolecular architecture.

synthesis.procedure: The DFX-Ce procedure was followed with Eu(NO3)3·6H2O replacing Ce(NO3)3·6H2O: the metal salt and DFX were stirred in water for 10 min at room temperature and heated in a Teflon-lined stainless-steel vessel under autogenous pressure. After slow cooling, crystals were filtered, washed with distilled water, and dried in air.

list_of_rare_earth_compounds.structure_description: The asymmetric unit contains four independent Tb(III) centers, ten bridging and two terminal chelating H2L− ligands, two bridging waters, and one terminal coordinated water. The reported Tb-containing dimer fragment contributes to cruciform-like one-dimensional chains; hydrogen bonds involving terminal groups connect the fragments, and further interchain hydrogen bonding and C–H⋯π interactions form a three-dimensional supramolecular architecture.

synthesis.procedure: Tb(NO3)3·6H2O and deferasirox were stirred in water for 10 min at room temperature, transferred to a Teflon-lined stainless-steel vessel, and heated under autogenous pressure. After slow cooling to room temperature, the crystals were filtered, washed with distilled water, and dried in air.
synthesis.vessel_or_method: 20 mL Teflon-lined stainless-steel vessel; hydrothermal reaction
synthesis.workup_and_crystallization: Slow cooling to room temperature yielded yellow-green prism crystals; filtered, washed with distilled water, and dried in air.
